decision.mechanism: Update the selected object's exact left/top/width/height CSS per RAF instead of cloning all objects and reconciling their React elements during move/resize; keep the same final commit, geometry, source images, rasterization and stacking.
decision.reason: No measured target benefit: objects phase median CPU +2.2%, P95 25.1 to 33.2 ms; whole-flow CPU -0.4% with overlapping ranges, main-thread duration unchanged. Quality passed, but the candidate did not improve the requested workflow. All six formal runs retained.
decision.quality: Final frozen Electron 24 same-phase pixel comparisons and 120 image raster/source/filter pairs exact; all six project/PDF output graphs equal except PDF dates. Initial screenshot and repeat-control one-channel differences are retained, not silently treated as zero.
decision.restoration: Only ObjectLayer.tsx restored; all 211 current production source/config hashes match measured baseline. New regression and diagnostic tooling retained.
decision.followup: Investigate object paint damage/raster invalidation and PDF input scheduler; trace longest objects-phase main tasks include Paint around 50-56 ms. Two traced runs are diagnostic only and are not merged into the six ordinary resource runs.
decision.energy: Uncalibrated CPU demand proxy only; no watts, joules or battery-life claim. GPU-process CPU is not GPU device activity.
